verdict.rationale: Tavily exposes a fully documented public REST API and Python SDK with clear endpoints (search, extract, crawl, map, research, qna_search, get_search_context) and rate-limit/error documentation, making it highly agent/AI-native friendly. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe returned 404s) and no independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs/SDK repo.
